class.name: LevelBrush
class.brief_description: A brush solid stored as explicit mesh topology (vertices + polygon faces).
class.description: LevelBrush stores a solid as local-space vertices and outward-wound n-gon faces, with an optional per-face material. Faces may be non-planar; they are fan-triangulated for rendering, collision, and occluders. Editing a vertex moves only that vertex and the faces deform to fit (Blender-style), while face extrusion creates new cap + wall geometry (Hammer-style). Brushes are added as children of a [LevelMap] node and can be moved, rotated, and scaled like any other [Node3D].

method.name: get_face_material
method.description: Returns the material assigned to [param face], or [code]null[/code].

method.name: get_vertex
method.description: Returns the local-space position of vertex [param index].

method.name: set_vertex
method.description: Sets the local-space position of vertex [param index].

method.name: setup_box
method.description: Initializes this brush as an axis-aligned box (8 vertices, 6 quad faces) covering [param aabb] in local space.
